observations.body: The vision’s interpretation places beastly kingdoms beside the saints receiving and possessing the kingdom forever.
observations.label: The saints receive the kingdom

observations.body: The passage places Human kingdom beside the saints receive the kingdom.
observations.label: Human kingdom

payload.posture: Read Daniel (Greek) 7:12–28 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the vision’s interpretation places beastly kingdoms beside the saints receiving and possessing the kingdom forever. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: The saints receive the kingdom
